full_judgment: Mohammad Abdur Rouf J: The plaintiffs by this petition have sought for leave to appeal against the judgment and decree dated 22 August 1993 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division dismissing First Appeal No. 87 of 1977 and affirming the judgment and decree dated 21 January 1977 passed by the Subordinate Judge, Additional Court Khulna in Title Suit No. 38 of 1974, a suit for declaration of tenancy right in respect of 44.84 acres of land, out of a raiyati holding comprising of 6.90 acres, appertaining to CS Khatian No. 25 of mouza Hodda, Police Station Paikgacha, District Khulna.
